steps.note: Resize/reflow (quadraui#918): the same relational geometry layout/shell.sidebar_left_of_main proves at 120 cols, re-asserted at a narrower LogicalViewport (90, still well above AppShell's with_min_width/with_max_width clamps of 8/50 line-heights). There is no mid-scenario 'resize' step in schema v0 — every act step is unit-free by construction (schema.rs's no-coordinates invariant) — so the portable way to express 'the shell must still be usable at a smaller size' is to start at that size and show the same relations still hold, rather than to grow/shrink mid-run.

The bottom status bar's right-priority hint segment (Tab=focus bar / q=quit) must still be reachable at the smaller width, not silently dropped by a reflow that only got tested at the original 120-column fixture.
